summary.text: Travis Holdman is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 19, which covers Adams, Blackford, Jay and Wells counties and a portion of Allen County, since March 2008.
He is the Majority Caucus Chair and chairs the Tax and Fiscal Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Holdman earned a B.A. from Southeast Missouri State University, an M.S. from the University of St. Francis and a J.D. from Indiana University.

He is an attorney with Holdman Consult/Holdman Law and previously served as a Wells County deputy prosecutor, on the Wells County Council and as chair of the Indiana Department of Financial Institutions board.
He also serves on the Appropriations and the Rules and Legislative Procedure committees.
The page says he is married with two children and five grandchildren.
